Apple is defending its slow move into AI. The new CEO said they only want to ship things people actually love instead of chasing trends. Are you buying the patient approach, or are tech giants just running out of ideas?

post.news: Apple CEO John Ternus said the company does not want to ship AI for AI sake and likes its current position.
post.take: That is a very polite way of saying we are just going to be late and call it thoughtful.
post.insight: Apple is turning its slow rollout into a branding choice, proving you can dodge being first if your fans are willing to wait.
